lead.hed: Defense News: two U.S. tankers left Bulgaria. A Friday exit is not a closed war.
lead.insight: Defense News, Monday 08:44 reprint of Saturday’s Reuters file: two U.S. Air Force KC-135s left Bulgaria’s Bezmer air base Friday, Defense Minister Dimitar Stoyanov told reporters. Parliament approved the temporary deployment July 22. Iran called it complicity; Sofia dismissed the charge. Stoyanov said the flights were training missions over allied countries and that Bulgaria had no information about a direct threat. A departure is not a basing deal. A minister’s quote is not a Pentagon order.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Air Force photo · DVIDS 9857797 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · An F-16 approaches a KC-135 boom in the CENTCOM area of responsibility, Aug. 7, 2026. Caption must say Aug. 7 CENTCOM, not Friday’s Bezmer departure.
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Air Force DVIDS still of a KC-135 Stratotanker refueling an F-16, Aug. 7, 2026, CENTCOM. Same-subject class as the Monday tanker file — not a Bulgaria ramp photo, not a Lincoln launch, not a brand tile. Same-turn CDN JPEG 200 / local 99799.

political.hed: USNI: Lincoln left 5th Fleet. A 7th Fleet box is not a homecoming.
political.insight: USNI Saturday, still the newest authorized Navy file this Monday AM: Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) left the Middle East after almost seven months and is in U.S. 7th Fleet. As of Saturday, Lincoln, escorts, and Carrier Air Wing 9 were in the Indian Ocean under INDOPACOM. A transit is not San Diego. Two tankers leaving Bulgaria is not Lincoln coming home.

political.hed: USNI: two mariners dead in Hormuz. A casualty count is not an open strait.
political.insight: USNI overnight Friday into Saturday, still on the Monday AM board: two mariners were killed in the past week and a half in the Strait of Hormuz by Iranian attacks. Monday’s hit on MV Minoan Dignity left one seafarer dead. Transits ticked up. Two dead is not a cleared lane. Tankers leaving Bezmer is not a restored corridor.

tech.hed: Defense News: Army ends Europe drone battalion. An experiment is not a force.
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday 08:14: after Saber Junction in August and September, the dedicated Europe drone battalion returns to airborne infantry. The official did not name the unit. CENTCOM’s one-way-attack task force is a different theater. A stand-down is not a drone holiday. A memo is not inventory.

tech.hed: Defense News: India asked into France’s sixth-gen jet. Talks are not a workshare.
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday 12:52: India’s Defense Ministry told parliament it has “initiated efforts in a concerted manner to co-join” France’s Future Combat Air System after Paris and Berlin dropped their joint fighter. Talks are not IP. A mock-up is not a jet.

tech.hed: Defense News: Navy wants a next-gen SeaSparrow. A notice is not a missile.
tech.insight: Defense News, Thursday: the Navy is leading a NATO SeaSparrow Project Office hunt for a new Evolved SeaSparrow variant. Sources Sought deadline Oct. 19. Ten-inch max, Mark 41 fit, 12 consortium nations. A SAM.gov notice is not inventory. Raytheon still builds Block II.

culture.hed: WORLD: Smith’s luminous dark. Mystical unknowing is not the gospel.
culture.insight: WORLD, Thursday: James K.A. Smith’s new Yale book asks readers to dwell in mystical non-knowing after a midlife crisis. The review’s point: union with God is through the knowable Mediator, not a cloud that erases revelation. A mood is not a creed. Certainty about Christ is not pride.

watch.hed: WATCH: Northern Viking is still underway. An opening ceremony is not today’s lead.
watch.insight: USNI Thursday file, still Watch on the Monday AM board: U.S., Iceland, and NATO began biennial Northern Viking 2026 on Tuesday; it runs through Sept. 3. Seventy-fifth year of the 1951 defense agreement. A kickoff is not a GIUK garrison. The Monday clock is the tanker exit.
